newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stocks up solidly at open as CPI pleases.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stocks up solidly at open as CPI pleases.

text.p: Wall Street stocks registered solid gains at the opening on Tuesday after a softer-than-expected rise in core consumer prices allayed inflation concerns.
The December Consumer Price Index (CPI) rose 0.3 percent, in line with forecasts. The core rate, which excludes food and energy, rose by only 0.1 percent, lower than forecast.
The Dow industrials rose 30 points to 6,740 and the S&P 500 gained six to 765. The Nasdaq Composite jumped nine points to 1,340.
